_readme: Source of truth for legal document versions used by the clickwrap acceptance flow (agree.html + _backend/acceptance). Edit by hand, then run: python3 _build/legal_manifest.py --write. Never change a version that has a content_sha256; add a new version entry instead. The legal owner (Tim, after counsel review) sets is_material_change. See /workspace/legal/DRAFT_clickwrap-spec_v0.1_2026-11-13.md sections 5 and 8.
